brief: A caddy to carry my bottle of bleach and a scrub brush around the house.

requirements.requirement: A caddy that can be carried around the house
requirements.evidence: Two-cell base (piece:0,0,0;full and piece:1,0,0;full) locked with jointBolt:0#0,0#0 and capped (capOpenFaces); no handle was added because a handle needs room on top of a cover which would close off a bin. Carrying by its rim is possible but there is no dedicated handle.

requirements.requirement: Holds a bottle of bleach upright
requirements.evidence: The full-depth open bin bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full gives a deep contained well (77 mm deep, ~142 mm across floor) that keeps a closed bottle sitting in the bottom; no taller bin was available because hex-bin-full-x2 requires a 2-storey base. Actual containment of bleach depends on the real bottle size and material choice, which the configurator does not check.

The second cell has the drained bin bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain for drips. A brush prop (prop:1, the only brush prop available) stands in the first bin; the configurator refused it in the drained bin ('no place to rest' over its drain surface), so the two items are not separated in the model as intended.

requirements.requirement: Carrying bleach safely in a 3D-printed caddy
requirements.evidence: The configurator checks fit and collisions only and knows nothing about materials, chemical resistance, or leak containment for bleach. Whether the printed material resists bleach must be confirmed by the user; only carrying the closed, sealed bottle should be considered.

finish.summary: Built a two-cell cleaning caddy: two full-depth bins side by side on locked, capped bases — one open well for a closed bleach bottle and one drained bin for a wet scrub brush (a stand-in brush and bottle-equivalent props were tested; staged brush sits in the bottle cell as the configurator would not rest it in the drained bin). Reported as compromise rather than built: there is no dedicated carry handle, and chemical resistance / safe bleach carriage cannot be verified in this tool — the material choice must be checked separately before real use.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
